cards.subject: Menethil Harbor
lines: Built after the Second War on reconquered ground, under the direction of Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore, and named in honour of Terenas Menethil II.
A Kul Tiran admiral's port, in a dwarven kingdom, named for a human king of a third country. Nobody local is commemorated.

cards.subject: Two boats, and then you walk
cards.tag: Why this swamp is full of level twelves
lines: Menethil runs the Lady Mehley south to Theramore and the Auberdine boat to Darkshore. That is all of Alliance sea travel.
The zone is twenty to twenty-five, and a flight path has to be walked to before it can be flown.
A fresh night elf stepping off that boat has no way to Ironforge except on foot, through crocolisks and Dragonmaw.

cards.subject: Tapoke "Slim" Jahn
lines: A human rogue drinking in the swamp bar, and he was involved in the kidnapping of Varian Wrynn, hired by the Defias.
The Stormwind chain that hunts him is called The Missing Diplomat. The missing man is the King.
Deleted from the game in 4.0.3a.

cards.subject: The colour of it
lines: Mists on the ground and an overcast sky make the whole zone a uniform grey.
Dun Modr besieged, Angerfang taken, the Thandol Span broken, Ironbeard's Tomb defiled.
The dwarves are losing this place in every direction at once.

cards.subject: Three dwarves on a rock
lines: It was a peaceful dig until mottled raptors overran it. Prospector Whelgar and two of his crew are stranded on a ridge above the site.
They are not fleeing and nobody is rescuing them.
They have been standing on that rock since 2004, and they were removed after Classic.

cards.subject: Ironbeard's Tomb
cards.tag: The crypt they built and did not use
lines: An unused dwarven crypt model exists that seems to have been meant for this tomb. A generic crypt went in instead.
What is there: a graveyard, a dwarven statue, and oozes in black, crimson and monstrous varieties.
Who Ironbeard was is recorded nowhere.

cards.subject: Thandol Span
cards.tag: The road to Lordaeron stops in mid-air
lines: Ironforge built the two arches after the War of the Three Hammers to reach their Wildhammer cousins.
Dark Irons under a warlock named Balgaras the Foul laid waste to it, and southern Dun Modr fell soon after.
Balgaras is a rare spawn in this zone. You can stand on the broken arch and then go and kill him.

cards.subject: The Dragonmaw
cards.tag: Squatting below the scene of the crime
lines: These are the orcs who chained Alexstrasza inside Grim Batol and bred red dragons for the war machine.
When she got free she tore the fortress apart and ate Nekros whole, and her dragons burned the clan's camps.
Their leader down here is Nek'rosh Skullcrusher — Nekros's son.

cards.subject: Thelgen Rock
cards.tag: The last corner of the map
lines: A cave running back into the southern mountains, full of poisonous spiders and Incendicite Ore.
The zone's fog of war will not clear until you go inside it.
Frustrated cartographers can be seen roaming the area trying in vain to finish their maps.

cards.subject: Sida's bag
cards.tag: Why the crypt was always busy
lines: The oozes at Ironbeard's Tomb were hunted for years for one rare drop: a lost bag.
It is why a low-level graveyard nobody had any reason to visit was permanently occupied.

cards.subject: Rethiel the Greenwarden
lines: Everywhere else in this swamp a bog beast is a thing you kill. One of them gives you quests.
"The land suffers... It cries for mercy, it cries for mercy."

cards.subject: Grim Batol
cards.tag: A door you will never open
lines: The road up ends at a massive closed door, guarded by red dragonkin far above the level of this zone.
It is shut on purpose: Alexstrasza and Korialstrasz decided it was the red flight's duty to seal the place off.
For six years it is the most-visited locked door in the game.
